SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. Hongkew Station,
No. S. B. D. 2109.
Date March 8th, 1931.
10 - 3 - 31.

Subject (in full) With reference to the attached.

Made by D.S.Stocks. Forwarded by

At 6.50 p.m. 4/3/31, Sgt. Bridges of the River Police
brought to Hongkew Station one giving his name as Hondra alias
Biskin who had been arrested by members of the River Police for
assaulting a customs officer, who had attempted to search the
above named person aboard the S.S.Kasaga Maru. Hondra alias
Biskin claimed Dual Nationality, i.e. Japanese and Italian.
The River Police informed the Japanese Consulate, who refused to
take jurisdiction over the arrested man. Sgt. Bridges requested
that the man be detained at Hongkew pending further enquiries.
The prisoner was escorted to the Italian Consulate and the
Italian Consul was interviewed. He stated that owing to the
lateness of the hour he was unable to decide the status of the
prisoner, but would take responsibility of the detention of the
prisoner until 10.30 a.m. 5/3/31, when he should be brought
before the Italian Court, and a decision of Jurisdiction would
be given. The prisoner was detained at Hongkew Station.
At 10.30 a.m. 5/3/31, the prisoner was brought before the
Italian Consulate Court, where the judge refused to take
Jurisdiction. The prisoner was then conveyed to the Chinese
City Court, where he is now detained.
The real name of the arrested person is Hanato alias Hondra,alias
Biskin, he was charged at Hongkew for unlawful possession of arms
and ammunitions and sentenced to six months imprisonment on the
15/10/30.

D.S. 188.

D.D.O, "G"
French.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
档案号
上海公共租界
虹口巡捕房，C. & S. 科，
编号 S. B. D. 2109。
日期：1931年3月8日。
10 - 3 - 31。

主题（全称）关于附件事宜。

由 D.S. Stocks 撰写。转呈者

1931年3月4日下午6时50分，水上巡捕房的 Bridges 警佐将一名自称 Hondra（别名 Biskin）的男子带至虹口巡捕房，该人因袭击海关官员而被水上巡捕房成员逮捕，当时该海关官员试图在“笠置丸”号（S.S. Kasaga Maru）轮船上搜查上述人员。Hondra（别名 Biskin）声称拥有双重国籍，即日本和意大利国籍。水上巡捕房通知了日本领事馆，但日方拒绝对该被捕男子行使管辖权。Bridges 警佐请求将该人拘押在虹口巡捕房，以待进一步调查。该囚犯被护送至意大利领事馆，并与意大利领事进行了面谈。领事表示，由于时间已晚，他无法确定该囚犯的身份地位，但愿意承担拘押该囚犯的责任，直至1931年3月5日上午10时30分，届时应将其带至意大利法庭，并对管辖权问题作出裁决。该囚犯被拘押在虹口巡捕房。
1931年3月5日上午10时30分，该囚犯被带至意大利领事馆法庭，法官拒绝行使管辖权。随后，该囚犯被移送至华界法院，目前正被拘押于此。
被捕者的真实姓名为 Hanato（别名 Hondra，别名 Biskin），他此前曾于1930年10月15日在虹口因非法持有武器弹药被起诉，并被判处六个月监禁。

D.S. 188。

副警务总监，“G”组
French。

Extract from Morning Translation of 5.3.31.

AN ITALIAN BRANDISHES KNIFE AT CUSTOM OFFICERS

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following report:-

About 5 p.m. yesterday several custom officers on
duty at Wayside Wharf held a suspicious looking passenger on
the S.S. Aio Maru, who was carrying a trunk in his hand.
The officers attempted to search the trunk but the man
brandished a knife. A report was made by telephone to
the Japanese Consulate which immediately dispatched police
officers to make an investigation.

On arrival at the wharf the Japanese Police
ascertained that the man was not Japanese but an Italian
married to a Japanese woman. They could not interfere
and return to the Japanese Consulate.

It is reported that at 7 p.m. the Water Police and
the Custom officers settled the trouble in some way
that has not been disclosed.

D.D.O. 'D'
Passed to you for information please

1931年3月6日。

1931年3月5日晨间译文摘录。

意大利人向海关官员挥刀相向

《上海日日新闻》刊登如下报道：-

昨日下午5时许，数名在汇山码头执勤的海关官员扣留了“爱欧丸”号（S.S. Aio Maru）轮船上一名手提行李箱、形迹可疑的乘客。官员们试图搜查该行李箱，但该男子挥舞刀具。随后通过电话向日本领事馆报案，日方立即派遣警官前往调查。

日本警察抵达码头后，查明该男子并非日本人，而是一名娶了日本妻子的意大利人。他们无法介入，遂返回日本领事馆。

据报道，晚上7时，水上巡捕房与海关官员以某种未公开的方式解决了此事。
